rising_weather_risk.description: Slow dry-soil build-up while live weather provides external context.

smoke_spike.description: Sudden smoke increase to exercise anomaly detection and risk escalation.

high_fire_demo.description: Manual demo scenario for sustained high smoke and dry soil leading to HIGH risk.

critical_fire_demo.description: Manual demo scenario for sustained critical smoke and very dry soil leading to CRITICAL risk.

water_tank_drop.description: Water reserve falls while fire risk may remain separate.

sprinkler_failure.description: Used by actuator_simulator to return FAILED after ACTIVATE_SPRINKLER.

missing_value.description: Drops value from one message to demonstrate validation failure.

unrealistic_value.description: Publishes impossible values to demonstrate validation filtering.

frozen_sensor.description: Repeats identical readings to demonstrate frozen-value anomaly detection.

sensor_dropout.description: Stops publishing smoke_level after startup to demonstrate missing stream detection.

no_response.description: Used by actuator_simulator to withhold or return NO_RESPONSE after a command.
